company.name: Lightdash
company.shortDescription: Lightdash is the first AI-native BI platform for technical data teams who are frustrated with complex, expensive traditional BI tools.
company.description:
Lightdash is the future of BI - an AI-first, open-source analytics platform that gives modern data teams the fastest path to true self-serve analytics. We integrate seamlessly with dbt and your existing stack, combining an open semantic layer, AI-powered analytics, and the best developer experience in BI.

Lightdash is trusted by fast-growing, data-driven companies worldwide to cut reporting bottlenecks, reduce BI costs, and ship analytics users actually adopt.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,000,000, or 56.7% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,898,859 to $54,120,087, a 9.17x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 88 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 88 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
